mainEntity.name: How do general contractors choose the right AEO service provider?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AEO service provider, general contractors should look for agencies with a proven track record in the construction or home services industry. Key considerations include their understanding of your specific market, experience with local SEO, and a clear methodology for identifying and optimizing for answer engine opportunities. Ask for case studies or examples of their success in securing featured snippets or voice search results for other businesses. Ensure they offer transparent reporting on relevant metrics and a strategy that aligns with your business goals, rather than just focusing on general SEO tactics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO provider with proven industry experience, local SEO expertise, a clear methodology, transparent reporting, and a strategy aligning with your business goals.
